title: thelypteris palustris var. pubescens
intro: Thelypteris palustris var. pubescens, commonly known as the pubescent shield fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris palustris var. pubescens include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic activities, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
